continue.resumed: Pick up where you left off

board.title: Meet the board
board.intro: Six parts you will use lab after lab. Drag the board to turn it; pick a part to light it up and see which labs use it.
board.model: 3D model of the ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1: the module with its antenna, two USB-C ports, BOOT and RST buttons, the RGB LED and two rows of header pins. Drag to turn it.
board.fallback: Every part is described in the cards.

usb.title: USB-C ports
usb.text: COM flashes the board and carries the serial monitor. USB is the S3's own port.

buttons.title: BOOT and RST
buttons.text: RST restarts your program. BOOT is GPIO 0: a free push button once the board runs.

rgb.title: RGB LED
rgb.text: One WS2812 on GPIO 48: 16 million colours from a single data pin.

module.title: ESP32-S3 module
module.text: Two 240 MHz cores, 16 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM under the metal can.

antenna.title: PCB antenna
antenna.text: Wi-Fi 4 and Bluetooth 5 leave from this copper zigzag: keep it clear of metal.

headers.title: Pin headers
headers.text: 44 pins: 3V3, 5V, GND and the GPIO you wire screens, readers and mics to.
